main:
Ourmethodology.

Every clinician at The Schoeman Clinic holds the full credential stack across four disciplines, considered together and never divided between departments.

Pillars
Four
Held by
Every clinician
Book an appointment
4-pillar

The Schoeman methodology

Every clinician holds the full stack. Most multi-doctor clinics separate these disciplines across different specialists; here, the same clinical mind understands the whole picture.

Higher training in conventional medicine

Clinical foundation

Foundation in conventional clinical medicine. The bedrock of safe, evidence-based diagnosis and treatment.

Hormone therapy

Bio-identical hormone optimisation across all hormonal systems, for men and women.

Functional medicine

Root-cause investigation: metabolic, gut, immunological and environmental drivers of disease.

Longevity medicine

Evidence-based protocols to extend health span through advanced biomarkers, epigenetics and biological age testing.

Begin a conversation
in confidence.

Introductions are handled personally by our patient office. Every enquiry is received with complete discretion and answered within one working day.
